content: Ndinga yayi yenina ya kyedika: Honi mutu kasola kukala mutwadisi, kisalu kya kitoku lawu kasodi.
Bulungi ni mutwadisi kakala konda kikalu, kafweti kala yakala wákwela mukhetu mosi, kisiku lutikisa kitesu, kadikengaka, kadizitisaka, kayambaka batu, kazaya kulonga,
kadihanaku mu kunwa malafu, kakalaku mukwa kingolu-ngolu; kaasi kakala mutu wa talala, mutu wa ngemba, kazolukaku mbongu;
katwadisaka bukheti nzu yandi amana bana bandi balemvukaka, mu luzitu lwosu.
Amana, honi mutu kisiku twadisa mboti batu benina muna nzu yandi, abweti kalenda twadisila Dibundu dya Nzambi?
Kakalaku mukidisitu wa pha; kondilo kaditsikisaka nana mu lulendu hanga ku tsuka kabonga nana ndola bwosu yina ya kiphidi-mutu.
Bulungini kakala yi kimbangi kya mboti kwena batu babana bakondi kala bakwikidi, ndangu bamulewulaku amana kabwa nana mu mutambu wa kiphidi-mutu
Basyelu phi mutindu wumosi, bulungini bakalaka batu ba luzitu amana bakalaku batu ba ndinga zodi; balendaku dihanaka ku malafu ata kusosa miluta mya luvunu;
bafweti simbidila diswekamu dya lukwikilu muna katsatsa ka kasemi.
Babazyamina theti ku thwala ya kusala kisalu, yuka ni bakala batu bakonda kikalu.
Mutindu mosi phi, bakhetu bafweti kala bana bisi zitisa, konda mbonzi, bisiku hitikisa kitesu, batu bisi sila mbundu mu mambu moosu.
Basyelu bafweti kwela kaka mukhetu mosi amana batwadisaka bukheti bana ba bawu yi nzu ya bawu meni.
Mukuma basyelu babana básalakya bukheti kisalu bábazatisa yi kikumbwala kya lukwikilu kina kyenina mwena Kidisitu Yesu.
Yikusonikini mukanda wawu yi kivuvu ni ka thama ku, yikwísa kutala.
Kaasi honi yizyeta, wazáya khi bikalulu wakadiki byawu mu nzu ya Nzambi, yina yenina Dibundu dya Nzambi wa moyu, yina yenina kunzi amana disi zyamisa mambu ma kyedika.
Eeh, bulungi lwazayabwa, diswekamu ditadidini mambu ma kinzambi dyenina dya mbuta:

content.text: kisa monika mu lutu lwa kimutu,
wádimonikisa mutu wa masonga muna nzila ya Kitembu Kyatoma
Batu báyadingisa musamu wa Kidisitu ha kati dya babana bakondi kala Bayuta,
bámutombula mu khembu ya ku zilu.
